description: A §59 map literal whose entry VALUE is a function fires E-VALUE-FUNCTION-STORED (§59.3, §14.3). `["double": twice]` stores the declared function `twice` in a map entry; a map is a value, and no value holds a function. Incidental W-PROGRAM-SPA-INFERRED / W-TYPE-031-UNPROVEN are ignored by superset matching.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S464 "Yes, maps too (Recommended)" (map literals are values too — a function-valued map entry is refused)
rationale: §59.3 a map entry SHALL NOT hold a function; the map literal entry and the §59.7 `.insert` write that would put one in are both E-VALUE-FUNCTION-STORED. To choose behaviour by key, store an enum tag and match on it.
